name: Abducted Doctor
comment: One of the three minifigures the Alien Mindslicer abducts (see npc/abducted-medic): TDB 51000 #1482 "Abducted Doctor" with the Witch Doctor's look (the user, 2026-10-30). It plants the Witch Doctor's totems (same look, tunables enemy_abilities). Which of the three hashes is which is a guess; the pick is random anyway.
